commands.summary: Confirmed the current client handshakes in one subprocess and invokes each operation in a separate subprocess, while the current engine reads one JSON object to EOF. Corrected the architecture recommendation: same-process handshake and explicit admission must precede the operation in that same engine image. Per-response identity checks alone occur after a side effect. Legacy engines that wait for EOF or omit identity receive no operation request.
